tema: Faça a narração em inglês com o tema: a sombra da mata
legenda: Uma noite na floresta mudou a minha vida para sempre. Minha própria sombra acabou virando meu único protetor! 🌲 E você, teria coragem de voltar para salvar sua própria sombra? Deixe sua resposta nos comentários! #TerrorLeve #HistoriaDeTerror #Mistério #HistoriasAnimadas
falas: I entered the dark forest at night, unaware that my own shadow was watching me from behind the trees.
When I raised my lantern, my shadow stayed completely still on the ground, refusing to move with me.
Suddenly, the shadow detached from my feet and slowly stood up right in front of my face.
It pointed deep into the woods, whispering a warning about an ancient monster lurking in the dark canopy.
Huge red glowing eyes appeared between the branches, approaching us with a terrifying, heavy metallic thud.
My shadow grabbed my hand, pulling me into a secret cave just as the creature violently smashed the path.
Now I am safe inside, but my shadow remains outside fighting the beast—would you go back to save it?
